title: English Practice Quiz 0941
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: When an interviewer asks about your strengths, you should mention ___.
questions.explanation: Relevant examples make your strengths credible.

questions.question: The STAR method in an interview helps you explain a situation, task, action and ___.
questions.explanation: STAR stands for Situation, Task, Action and Result.

questions.question: If you do not understand an interview question, you should ___.
options: politely ask the interviewer to repeat or clarify it
questions.explanation: Asking for clarification helps you answer accurately.

questions.question: A suitable answer to 'Why do you want this job?' should connect your skills with ___.
questions.explanation: A focused answer explains why your abilities and goals fit the position.

questions.question: Arriving early for an interview gives you time to ___.
questions.explanation: Arriving early reduces stress and allows time for practical arrangements.

questions.question: A professional interview introduction should include your name and ___.
options: a brief summary of relevant experience
questions.explanation: A concise introduction gives the interviewer relevant background.

questions.question: After an interview, a brief thank-you message can ___.
questions.explanation: A polite thank-you note is a professional courtesy.

questions.question: If asked about a weakness, it is useful to describe ___.
options: an area you are improving and steps you take
a personal attack on a former manager
a skill you claim to have mastered perfectly
questions.explanation: A thoughtful answer shows self-awareness and willingness to improve.

questions.question: A candidate should research an employer before an interview to understand its ___.
questions.explanation: Research helps candidates give relevant answers and ask informed questions.

questions.question: When discussing a previous job, you should avoid ___.
options: sharing confidential information from that employer
questions.explanation: Confidential information should remain protected even after leaving a job.
